title: Post Malone's security detail sees a spectral image in Homestead 2

tellings.quote: we we had post malone he had a whole security detail with him we're talking arm to the teeth they ended up having an experience they ended up seeing a spectral image dart through and up through the roof

plain: Brandon Fugal, the owner of Skinwalker Ranch, a property in Utah known for reports of strange happenings, says the well-known musician Post Malone once visited with a heavily armed security team. According to Fugal, the security team saw a ghostly figure dart through a ranch building called Homestead 2 and up through the roof. He tells it because even tough, trained guards say they saw something they could not explain.
